faqs.answer: In Mesa's climate, our carpets typically dry in just 1-2 hours - sometimes even faster in the summer! Our Hot Carbonating Extraction uses about 80% less water than steam cleaning, so you're not left with soaking wet carpets for days.

faqs.question: How does your process handle Mesa's desert dust?
faqs.answer: Mesa's fine desert dust is particularly challenging because it embeds deep in carpet fibers. Our Hot Carbonating Extraction uses millions of carbonating bubbles that penetrate deep and lift the dust up and out - not just push it around on the surface. We also pre-vacuum and pre-treat high-traffic areas to ensure thorough dust removal.

faqs.question: Are your cleaning products safe in the Arizona heat?
faqs.answer: Yes! The Natural®, our primary cleaning solution, is gentle and contains no harsh chemicals, soaps, or fragrances. Plus, because we use so little water and your carpets dry quickly, there's no worry about moisture-related issues.
